summary: The root نون (nwn) refers to the dimple in a young child's chin. It is synonymous with terms like خُنْعُبَةٌ and قَلْتَةٌ, describing this specific facial feature.
lane: نَوْنَةٌ ذ The dimple in the chin of a young child: (M, K:) see خُنْعُبَةٌ , and قَلْتَةٌ , and دَائِرَةٌ , and 2 in art. دسم .
